scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @mystery/api" "npm run dev -w @mystery/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mystery/shared && npm run build -w @mystery/api && npm run build -w @mystery/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @mystery/shared && npm run typecheck -w @mystery/api && npm run typecheck -w @mystery/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @mystery/api && npm run test -w @mystery/web
